e_maria.name: 玛丽亚
e_maria.desc: 蒙特马约尔侯爵夫人，住在利马，用信件维系与远方女儿的关系。
e_maria.look: Elderly Peruvian noblewoman, red wig slightly askew, tired broad lined face, anxious intelligent brown eyes, brown brocade dress and fur-trimmed mantle.

child.look: The same woman as an awkward ten-year-old girl, straight chestnut hair, wide anxious brown eyes, plain formal dress burdened with heavy gold jewelry.

young.look: The same woman at twenty-six, broad unidealized face, chestnut hair pinned up, anxious brown eyes, brown-gold wedding dress, no red wig.

middle.look: The same woman around thirty-six, chestnut hair in a modest updo, broad anxious face, brown colonial brocade dress, no gray hair or old-age wrinkles.

e_clara.name: 克拉拉
e_clara.desc: 玛丽亚的女儿，聪明而自持，婚后远赴西班牙，也慷慨帮助身边的人。
e_clara.look: Adult Spanish-Peruvian noblewoman, tall poised figure, chestnut hair, pale olive skin, intelligent restrained eyes, elegant ivory and sage dress, no modern makeup.

child.look: Eight-year-old girl, chestnut hair neatly pinned, intelligent composed brown eyes, pale ivory colonial dress, clearly a child.

e_pepita.name: 佩皮塔
e_pepita.desc: 由修院养大的少女，被送去给侯爵夫人作伴，尽力承担超出年龄的期待。
e_pepita.look: Fourteen-year-old Peruvian orphan girl, medium olive-brown complexion, dark brown eyes, oval face, straight dark-brown hair braided and pinned low, faded brown dress with ivory collar, no jewelry.

e_abbess.name: 皮拉尔院长
e_abbess.desc: 圣罗莎修院的管理者，照料病人与孤儿，为妇女争取尊严，也急于为自己的事业寻找接班人。
e_abbess.look: Older stout Peruvian abbess, plain scrubbed ruddy face, kind intense black eyes, black veil and cream wimple, worn dark habit, practical hands, no luxury ornament.

e_camila.name: 卡米拉
e_camila.desc: 从咖啡馆歌女成长为名演员，艺名佩里科尔；在舞台、情爱、体面身份与母亲的责任之间寻找生活。
e_camila.look: Adult Peruvian actress, fine long nose, olive complexion, dark expressive eyes, dark wavy hair pinned back, tired slightly childish mouth at rest, muted terracotta theatre gown.

child.look: Lanky twelve-year-old Peruvian girl, dark untidy hair, hungry narrow face, long limbs, worn plain brown dress, no jewelry, no adult glamour.

ill.look: Same adult actress after smallpox, dignified tired face with subtle healed pitted marks, plain dark veil and simple brown dress; never grotesque, no open lesions.

e_pio.name: 皮奥
e_pio.desc: 人们叫他叔叔，实际并无亲缘；见多识广的漂泊者和戏剧导师，对才华的热爱夹杂着掌控他人的愿望。
e_pio.look: Thin Castilian man around fifty, sparse moustache and wispy short beard, large sad alert black eyes, receding dark hair, weathered unhandsome face, worn brown coat.

young.look: Same thin Castilian man in his thirties, short dark hair, sparse moustache and beard, alert large dark eyes, plain worn brown coat.

e_esteban.name: 埃斯特班
e_esteban.desc: 在修院长大的双胞胎之一，与兄弟共同劳动，习惯把两人的生活看作整体。
e_esteban.look: Twenty-two-year-old Peruvian twin man, straight-backed lean laborer, dark uncut hair, black eyes under a heavy fringe, olive skin, plain faded brown shirt. Physically indistinguishable from Manuel; no distinguishing scar or color code.

e_manuel.name: 曼努埃尔
e_manuel.desc: 埃斯特班的双生兄弟，做过抄写员与苦力，对女演员产生难以言说的倾慕。
e_manuel.look: Twenty-two-year-old Peruvian twin man, same face and body as Esteban, straight-backed lean laborer, dark uncut hair, black eyes under a heavy fringe, olive skin, plain faded brown shirt. No artificial distinguishing scar or color code.

e_captain.name: 阿尔瓦拉多船长
e_captain.desc: 走过许多海域的航海者，寡言、可靠，女儿的去世长久地留在他的生活中。
e_captain.look: Broad strong older sea captain, deeply weathered sun-darkened face, plain short dark-gray hair, gray stubble, steady sad eyes, simple dark wool coat, no pirate symbols or modern uniform.

e_jaime.name: 海梅
e_jaime.desc: 卡米拉与总督的儿子，体弱而严肃，珍惜阳光，不愿让别人看见自己的发作。
e_jaime.look: Delicate small boy, dark thoughtful eyes and forehead like Camila, pale olive skin, fine dark hair, worn garnet velvet clothes, quiet dignity, no exaggerated illness. Age at accident unspecified; portray a young child.

e_viceroy.name: 安德烈斯总督
e_viceroy.desc: 秘鲁总督，卡米拉的恋人，精于宫廷礼仪，也受病痛、权势与厌倦困扰。
e_viceroy.look: Aging grand Spanish viceroy, heavy dignified face, graying curled hair, rich but restrained dark burgundy coat, sedentary posture, amber candlelight, no fantasy crown.

e_archbishop.name: 利马大主教
e_archbishop.desc: 爱好语言、音乐与美食，也常为行动寻找推辞的教会高位者。
e_archbishop.look: Heavy older cleric with a large face, small kindly witty black eyes, violet satin clerical robes, pearl-pale hands, humane literary portrait without caricature.

e_juniper.name: 胡尼佩尔
e_juniper.desc: 目睹桥难的方济各会修士，用多年调查追问五个人的死亡是否具有天意。
e_juniper.look: Small earnest middle-aged Franciscan friar, close-cropped dark hair with modest tonsure, weathered gentle face, plain brown wool habit and cord belt, a simple bound notebook.

e_lima.name: 利马
e_lima.desc: 小说中人们交错生活的城市，教堂、剧院、宅邸与码头各有自己的声音。
e_lima.look: Colonial Lima around 1714, adobe walls, wooden balconies and cathedral towers, pedestrians in period dress, no modern vehicles.

e_palace.name: 侯爵府
e_palace.desc: 玛丽亚在利马的宅邸，华贵、宽敞，却容纳着母女间长久的疏离。
e_palace.look: Peruvian baroque domestic mansion, green carved wooden balcony, writing desk, faded rich fabrics, quiet empty rooms.

e_spain.name: 西班牙
e_spain.desc: 克拉拉婚后的居所，也是秘鲁许多人不断回望的远方。
e_spain.look: Distant eighteenth-century Spanish harbor and warm stone town seen across a gray-blue sea, a small sailing vessel.

e_harbor.name: 利马海港
e_harbor.desc: 远行者和海运货物往返的海岸，母女的告别与兄弟的劳动都发生在这里。
e_harbor.look: Eighteenth-century Peruvian Pacific harbor, wooden sailing ships, hand-carried crates and simple boats, pearl clouds over water.

e_convent.name: 圣罗莎修院
e_convent.desc: 院长照料孤儿与病人的地方，有洗衣池、病房和每日需要筹措的开销。
e_convent.look: Austere colonial Peruvian convent courtyard, stone laundry trough, white linen, shade trees, warm adobe walls and open cloister.

e_theatre.name: 利马剧院
e_theatre.desc: 演员与抄写员谋生的场所，舞台上的喝彩与后台的苛求往往同时存在。
e_theatre.look: Small colonial theatre, candlelit stage, upper wooden boxes, faded curtain, intimate practical backstage, no electric light.

e_shrine.name: 克卢克桑布夸圣所
e_shrine.desc: 安第斯山中的朝圣地，白墙、钟声、喷泉与清澈的空气环绕着它。
e_shrine.look: Whitewashed Andean sanctuary in a small mountain town, stone fountain, llamas and layered peaks, clear cold afternoon.

e_inn.name: 山中客栈
e_inn.desc: 朝圣途中暂住的房间，两封命运不同的信在这里被写下、读到或撕毁。
e_inn.look: Modest colonial Andean inn room, rough table, charcoal brazier, wicker hampers, candle and quill, mountain light.

e_room.name: 双胞胎的房间
e_room.desc: 兄弟共住的出租房，两张床与一张抄写桌见证了默契、隔阂和照料。
e_room.look: Plain rented room in colonial Lima, two simple cots, wooden copying table, candle, basin and folded cloth, no modern furniture.

e_cuzco.name: 库斯科
e_cuzco.desc: 埃斯特班漂泊后做抄写工作的城镇，船长到这里邀请他远航。
e_cuzco.look: Colonial Cuzco inn and highland square, layered stone foundations, Andes and clear cool dawn light.

e_court.name: 总督府
e_court.desc: 礼仪繁复的权力中心，也有聚谈到天明、暂时排遣乡愁的夜宴。
e_court.look: Colonial Peruvian palace supper room, tall window facing dawn, brocade tablecloth, fruit, chocolate cups and fading candles.

e_garden.name: 法式花园
e_garden.desc: 山中仿照欧洲营建的花园，皮奥与卡米拉曾在黄昏的长椅旁交谈。
e_garden.look: French formal garden terraces in the Andes, chipped marble bench, balustrade and distant Pacific-facing valleys, dusk clouds.

e_villa.name: 卡米拉的山庄
e_villa.desc: 卡米拉离开城市后的住所，病后紧闭的门窗使照料与拒绝反复相遇。
e_villa.look: Secluded eighteenth-century Andean country villa, weathered adobe, closed wooden shutters, modest farm outbuildings, dewy grass.

e_bridge.name: 圣路易斯雷大桥
e_bridge.desc: 横跨河谷的植物纤维索桥，薄木板承载行人；五条不同的人生在一次寻常过河中相遇。
e_bridge.look: Intact narrow braided-fiber suspension footbridge with thin wood planks across a deep Peruvian gorge, no stone arches or steel.

e_jewels.name: 珠宝
e_jewels.desc: 身份与爱意常借它们表达，也可能变成负担或必须退还的馈赠。
e_jewels.look: Old gold earrings and necklaces on plain brown cloth, understated colonial jewelry, warm daylight, no modern display case.

e_goldchain.name: 金链
e_goldchain.desc: 克拉拉希望母亲替国王另寻的首饰，在信中变成一次走入画作的想象。
e_goldchain.look: Fine seventeenth-century Spanish gold chain on a folded cream letter beside a corner of an old oil portrait, no legible writing.

e_letters.name: 母女书信
e_letters.desc: 在秘鲁与西班牙之间往返的信件，既有机智的见闻，也有未能当面承受的索求与迟来的宽厚。
e_letters.look: Bundle of folded handwritten letters, wax seal, feather quill and green wooden balcony light; writing indistinct.

e_porridge.name: 粥
e_porridge.desc: 侯爵夫人常吃的食物，佩皮塔会特意向客栈厨子交代做法。
e_porridge.look: Simple earthenware bowl of plain rice porridge on a worn inn table, warm steam and a wooden spoon.

e_charcoal.name: 木炭
e_charcoal.desc: 山中房间取暖所需的燃料，照看火盆也是佩皮塔的日常差事。
e_charcoal.look: Unlit black charcoal pieces in a small rough basket beside a clay brazier, gentle side light.

e_secretletters.name: 秘密情书
e_secretletters.desc: 卡米拉交给曼努埃尔代笔的私信，收信人另有其人，内容须保密。
e_secretletters.look: Two separate folded letters beside an actress's stage wig and a small payment coin, quill on table, no readable words.

e_scripts.name: 戏剧抄本
e_scripts.desc: 需要抄写、背诵与排练的西班牙剧作，连接着兄弟的劳动与演员的技艺。
e_scripts.look: Hand-copied seventeenth-century Spanish drama pages with quill and plain leather binding, illegible writing, backstage table.

e_medicine.name: 药剂与膏药
e_medicine.desc: 理发师兼外科医师开出的治疗用品，未能使曼努埃尔的伤病好转。
e_medicine.look: Plain small period earthenware medicine jar, folded linen and wooden spoon on a humble bedside table, no modern labels.

e_cloth.name: 冷湿布
e_cloth.desc: 医师吩咐每小时更换的敷布，成了照料者不敢停下、病人害怕到来的事。
e_cloth.look: Wet linen cloth over the rim of a simple water basin, a bedside candle and dawn light, no wound.

e_crucifix.name: 十字架
e_crucifix.desc: 病中的曼努埃尔曾借它起誓，收回疼痛中伤害兄弟的话。
e_crucifix.look: Small plain worn wooden crucifix resting on cream bed linen, natural light, respectful unadorned still life.

e_coin.name: 钱币
e_coin.desc: 代笔的酬金与孩子的零用，显出不同关系里同一物件的不同分量。
e_coin.look: A single worn Spanish colonial gold coin on a plain wooden surface, historical indistinct embossing, no legible date.

e_gift.name: 给院长的礼物
e_gift.desc: 埃斯特班离开前想购买的赠礼，他希望也代表亡兄；具体物品未被写明。
e_gift.look: A small open cloth money pouch and two cups on an inn table, an intentionally empty space where a future gift would be; do not invent a purchased object.

e_shawl.name: 披巾
e_shawl.desc: 皮奥与卡米拉巡游时曾共用来包裹衣物，见证过旅途中的匮乏。
e_shawl.look: Worn brown woven shawl tied around a modest bundle of clothing on a quiet Pacific beach, soft dawn.

e_mirror.name: 化妆镜
e_mirror.desc: 演员整理面容的日常用具，也映出疲倦、病后希望和不期而来的注视。
e_mirror.look: Small old framed mirror on a modest dressing table, pale cosmetic bowl and folded cloth, no reflected person, dignified quiet.

e_stone.name: 发亮的小石头
e_stone.desc: 母亲给海梅的小物件，让他在失眠的黑夜里观看，材质未被原著说明。
e_stone.look: Extreme close-up of only a child's open palm holding one small ordinary pale mineral stone, dim soft light, no face or body, no magical aura or symbols.

e_loneliness.name: 孤独
e_loneliness.desc: 在人群、家庭与华贵房间里，都可能找不到可以放心开口的人。
e_loneliness.look: Two chairs separated by a patch of cold light in an otherwise warm colonial room, restrained symbolic still life.

e_obedience.name: 服从
e_obedience.desc: 习惯听从要求的女孩，有时难以判断自己何时可以离开原地。
e_obedience.look: Long church-square shadow approaching a child's plain empty shoes at a doorstep, gentle symbolic illustration, no person.

e_courage.name: 勇气
e_courage.desc: 一个女孩用它评判求助信，一位母亲却由此开始重新审视自己怎样去爱。
e_courage.look: A quill set down beside a fresh blank sheet and a torn letter, first dawn light on a rough table, no text.

e_language.name: 双生私语
e_language.desc: 兄弟自幼创造的语言，只在彼此之间使用，外人的好奇使它难以开口。
e_language.look: Two close trails of pale ink curling together but remaining unreadable on warm paper, intimate hand-drawn rhythm, no invented alphabet.

e_applause.name: 掌声
e_applause.desc: 它可以赞美技艺，也能纵容伤人；观众的热烈不保证台上人的满足。
e_applause.look: Softly rendered clapping hands in a candlelit theatre audience, warm light and uncertain dark stage beyond, no faces.

e_respectability.name: 体面身份
e_respectability.desc: 卡米拉离开剧场后努力争取的社会位置，带来新的门槛，也未消除旧的不安。
e_respectability.look: A rich colonial glove resting beside a worn theatre shoe on a threshold, understated contrast, no words.

e_providence.name: 天意
e_providence.desc: 胡尼佩尔试图用调查证明的安排；书中人物有不同理解，事实并未给出定论。
e_providence.look: An unfinished hand-ruled investigation table with plain rows and columns on a desk beside a mountain window, quill and ink, no people, no legible words or numbers, no occult or geometric symbols.

e_care.name: 照料
e_care.desc: 在人不能替彼此解除痛苦时，留下、送水、准备食物，仍是可以做的事。
e_care.look: A lantern and a pitcher of water beside clean linen in a modest convent sickroom, warm ordinary light, no miraculous imagery.
